principle: Aesthetic preferences differ by country, age, education and gender, so an average is not a target; preferences should be learned per person or segment.
detect: A single style applied to everyone without any signal about who the audience is.
fix: Offer directions as choices rather than one answer, and record which ones a given person picks.

source.title: Quantifying visual preferences around the world
source.author: Reinecke & Gajos (2014)
